reviews.comment: Amazing professor, incredibly interesting class, and he is so knowledgeable and supportive while learning the topics. Its an easy class but you definitely have to put thought an effort into the assignments. Fair amount of reading, but not much work at all. I'd highly recommend it was one of the most interesting and well done classes I've taken.

Very straightforward class. The class is pretty reading heavy. Expect to read at least 15-20+ pages before each class most of the time with a few exceptions. You will also have to write a few essays each month. The longest essay is about 2500 words. Professor Crider is nice and makes the class engaging and interesting. Overall, pretty easy class.

I really enjoyed each of his lectures and his approach to the class. There are daily quizzes over readings, but they are easy and he is lenient. Essays were the same way. I loved this class and would highly recommend; Dr. Crider makes it interesting and I found myself laughing a lot! He has a true passion for this subject, which is refreshing.

Dr. Crider is great. Lots of reading, and some of it is pretty difficult, but he always goes over it in class to help you understand. The class has a few essays, but he lets you approach them however you want. You also spend time visiting archives, using a printing press, and making your own "writing machine." Most hands on class I have taken here.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Crider is a good, approachable, and passionate instructor who is easy to talk to. He is openly very left-leaning in class, so keep that in mind. Expect heavy pre-class reading, sometimes up to 30 pages. The final group project is confusing, but he grades leniently and offers grace; the workload is demanding but manageable with planning.
reviews.ratingTags: Group projects--Graded by few things--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: Dr. Crider was great. Course is pretty clear from the get-go. Majority of work consists of readings before class, as he gives a quiz at the start every class (also used for attendance). Discussions are very casual and lowkey. Very caring professor who actively tries to help you. Very accessible outside of class and very lenient on attendance.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Caring--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: As with any ENGL210 class, there's a lot of assignments. However, Dr. Crider doesn't overload it, the amount of work is just right. Weekly writing around 400 words, 4 projects, lots of group work. He goes with the flow and genuinely wants to make the class exactly what the students need to get out of it. Love his humor and how he breaks info down!

Professor Crider was my favorite professor last semester. His lectures in class are based on readings that you do outside of class. Lectures are graded on participation. You can either get the participation grade by discussing your thoughts of the readings or taking notes of the lecture. There is no tests except for the final exam. He is very nice.

Professor Crider is truly one of the nicest profs I have had. He never wants to make anyone feel stressed, and his assignments are very easy and he grades easy. He is very understanding ona lot of things and gives his students grace. Truly amazing

Professor Crider is great! I do not enjoy reading, but he makes his class bearable. His lectures are engaging and he is understanding when it comes to late work. He does take attendance, which I didnt like. The reading speed can feel heavy, but its doable. Hes very passionate about his work and is very kind, I def recommend him!
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Going into this class I was a little worried as this was my first english class since high school, but taking this class was the best decision I have ever made. Dr. Crider is absolutely amazing and so inspiring. The points he brings up in lecture really make you think. There is reading if course, but nothing too heavy. TAKE THIS CLASS.

1-2 hr readings for every class, and weekly ~150-word writings. There are short 3 question quizzes over readings at the beginning of class which is how he takes attendance. Easy grader and grade points are fairly distributed across assignments. Class is mostly discussion based for participation points. Highly recommend this class.

I really enjoyed Dr. Crider's class, you can tell he is knowledgeable about the material and likes what he is discussing. You can tell he cares about the students. The readings are very dense and long, but he makes sure to explain everything in class. I really enjoyed all of the essays and discussions that took place in this class, would recommend.

A shining gem of my semester. So kind and understanding, willing to work with you on assignments. Super cool dude and a super cool course. Lots of reading but he makes sure you understand the main points and ties in real-world examples often

I love Jason, this dude is a great teacher. Mr. Crider provided so much information, while keeping the course entertaining. He also provided valuable feedback. I love this dude to the fullest extent!!!!!
